_about: Photo library for Healthy Money Daily. Every file is assets/photos/<key>-1600.webp and <key>-800.webp (WebP, 3:2 or 4:3). All photos are from Unsplash under the Unsplash License (free for commercial use, no permission needed, credit appreciated). Add new ones with: python3 -I scripts/blog_publish.py <slug> --image-file PATH --image-alt '...' --image-credit 'Name' --image-credit-url URL. 'mood' and 'fits' help the publisher pick; 'pos' is the CSS object-position used when the photo is cropped.
